cards.text: The word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel, a priest living in the land of the Chaldeans (Ezekiel 1:3). God calls him "Son of man" and opens with a question about the wood of the vine. Friend, I'm a stamper with my name carved in my handle, so a question about WOOD has me sweating already.

cards.question: God asks Ezekiel how the wood of the vine measures up against something else. Against what?

answers.text: The branches of the forest trees
The reeds of the Nile river
The stalks of the wheat field

cards.text: Then God gets down to it: can you make ANYTHING useful out of vine wood? Not a table, not a door, friend, I mean the tiniest, most bottom-of-the-list job a piece of wood could ever get.

cards.question: God asks if vine wood can even be made into a ___ to hang utensils on.
God has been asking what vine wood could be made into. What does He say is actually done with it?

answers.text: It is cast into the fire for fuel
It is carved into a walking staff
It is left to rot in the field

cards.text: The fire devours both ends and chars the middle, and God asks if it can be useful for anything now. Friend, that's my first batch the day the oven timer quit: ends GONE, middle black, and me holding up the tray asking, "Can we call this crispy?"

cards.question: True or false: God says that even when the vine wood was whole, before any fire touched it, it still couldn't be made useful.

cards.text: Then it turns. I was sitting here thinking we'd signed up for a woodworking class, and then comes "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:"

cards.question: Like the vine wood He has given to the fire for fuel, God says He will give up a people. Which people?

cards.text: God says He will set His face against them. Not a glance, friend, His FACE, and I think the next line is the hardest one in this whole message.

cards.question: True or false: God says that though the people of Jerusalem may have escaped the fire, yet another fire will consume them.
When God sets His face against the people of Jerusalem, what does He tell Ezekiel will be known?

answers.text: That the vine will grow back

cards.text: Last line. God says He will make the land desolate, and unlike that key from my drawer, nobody's left guessing on this one: He says exactly why.

cards.question: God says He will make the land desolate because the people have acted ___.
